verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025, Share and shareholders section

candidate_sentences.text: Cash increased to EUR 219.8 million, while interest-bearing liabilities declined to EUR 1.071 billion from EUR 1.223 billion.
Net debt fell to EUR 851.6 million, and net debt to EBITDA improved to 3.7 from 4.0.
Infortar paid EUR 62 million in dividends during 2025 and proposed a dividend of EUR 3.02 per share for the 2025 results.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic initiatives focused on portfolio diversification, particularly expanding into agriculture and renewable energy, with investments in biomethane production and solar power to enhance long-term resilience and align with climate goals.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO, Events in 2025 (agriculture acquisitions, renewable investments)

candidate_sentences.text: The Group expanded and diversified its portfolio during the year.
Infortar Agro acquired 96.57% of Estonia Farmid for EUR 37.8 million, acquired full ownership of Oisu Biogaas, and continued developing biomethane production.
Elenger commissioned a 4.9 MW solar plant in Latvia and completed an 8.0 MWh battery-storage facility.
